exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis using FIWC, NICE-2015, and IADPSG criteria
outcome: Perinatal outcomes including cesarean section, obstetric hemorrhage, and preeclampsia
cohort: 999 pregnant adolescents under 19 years old who underwent GDM screening
finding: The prevalence of GDM in adolescents varied significantly depending on the diagnostic criteria used (3% FIWC, 14.4% NICE, 29.3% IADPSG), and associations were found between GDM diagnosis by specific criteria and adverse pregnancy outcomes such as cesarean section, obstetric hemorrhage, and preeclampsia.
